description: Fork of exp193+exp194 ideas. Two changes vs exp193: (1) out_proj MLP widened from 4*E=1536 to 16*E=6144 (the block has no separate FFN sub-layer, so this is the only knob for per-block nonlinear capacity); (2) head untied from tok_emb (own [VOCAB, E] std=0.02 tensor). fc1 std=0.02, fc2 zero-init unchanged. Total params ~76M.
